```c
/* BTF-defined Map for AF_XDP sockets */
struct {
    __uint(type, BPF_MAP_TYPE_XSKMAP);
    __uint(key_size, sizeof(__u32));
    __uint(value_size, sizeof(__u32));
    __uint(max_entries, 64);
} xsks_map SEC(".maps");

SEC("xdp")
int spotnik_xdp_filter(struct xdp_md *ctx) {
    void *data_end = (void *)(long)ctx->data_end;
    void *data     = (void *)(long)ctx->data;

    /* Parse Ethernet Header */
    struct ethhdr *eth = data;
    if ((void *)(eth + 1) > data_end)
        return XDP_PASS;

    if (eth->h_proto != bpf_htons(ETH_P_IP))
        return XDP_PASS;

    /* Parse IPv4 Header */
    struct iphdr *ip = (void *)(eth + 1);
    if ((void *)(ip + 1) > data_end)
        return XDP_PASS;

    if (ip->protocol != IPPROTO_UDP)
        return XDP_PASS;

    /* Parse UDP Header */
    struct udphdr *udp = (void *)(ip + 1);
    if ((void *)(udp + 1) > data_end)
        return XDP_PASS;

    /* Check target port match */
    if (udp->dest == bpf_htons(SPOTNIK_TARGET_PORT)) {
        /* Redirect matching packet to AF_XDP socket bound to this RX queue.
         * If no socket is mapped to this queue_index, fallback to XDP_PASS. */
        return bpf_redirect_map(&xsks_map, ctx->rx_queue_index, XDP_PASS);
    }

    /* Pass non-matching traffic to Linux network stack */
    return XDP_PASS;
}

char _license[] SEC("license") = "GPL";

```

---

**Userspace Loader & AF_XDP Handler (`spotnik_xdp_user.c`)**

```c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <net/if.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <linux/if_xdp.h>
#include <bpf/libbpf.h>
#include <bpf/bpf.h>

#define NUM_FRAMES 2048
#define FRAME_SIZE 2048
#define UMEM_SIZE  (NUM_FRAMES * FRAME_SIZE)

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc < 2) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Usage: %s <ifname>\n", argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }

    const char *ifname = argv[1];
    unsigned int ifindex = if_nametoindex(ifname);
    if (!ifindex) {
        perror("if_nametoindex failed");
        return 1;
    }

    /* 1. Allocate aligned UMEM memory frame buffer */
    void *bufs = mmap(NULL, UMEM_SIZE, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
                      MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_POPULATE, -1, 0);
    if (bufs == MAP_FAILED) {
        perror("mmap allocation failed");
        return 1;
    }

    /* 2. Create raw AF_XDP socket */
    int xsk_fd = socket(AF_XDP, SOCK_RAW, 0);
    if (xsk_fd < 0) {
        perror("AF_XDP socket creation failed");
        return 1;
    }

    /* 3. Register UMEM memory region with AF_XDP socket */
    struct xdp_umem_reg mr = {
        .addr       = (uint64_t)bufs,
        .len        = UMEM_SIZE,
        .chunk_size = FRAME_SIZE,
        .headroom   = 0,
    };
    if (setsockopt(xsk_fd, SOL_XDP, XDP_UMEM_REG, &mr, sizeof(mr)) < 0) {
        perror("setsockopt XDP_UMEM_REG failed");
        return 1;
    }

    /* 4. Configure RX ring buffer size */
    uint32_t rx_entries = 1024;
    if (setsockopt(xsk_fd, SOL_XDP, XDP_RX_RING, &rx_entries, sizeof(rx_entries)) < 0) {
        perror("setsockopt XDP_RX_RING failed");
        return 1;
    }

    /* 5. Bind socket to specific network interface & RX queue 0 */
    uint32_t queue_id = 0;
    struct sockaddr_xdp sxdp = {
        .sxdp_family   = AF_XDP,
        .sxdp_flags    = XDP_SHARED_UMEM,
        .sxdp_ifindex  = ifindex,
        .sxdp_queue_id = queue_id,
    };
    if (bind(xsk_fd, (struct sockaddr *)&sxdp, sizeof(sxdp)) < 0) {
        perror("AF_XDP socket bind failed");
        return 1;
    }

    /* 6. Load compiled eBPF object file */
    struct bpf_object *obj = bpf_object__open_file("spotnik_xdp_kern.o", NULL);
    if (libbpf_get_error(obj)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to open eBPF object file\n");
        return 1;
    }

    if (bpf_object__load(obj)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to load eBPF object into kernel\n");
        return 1;
    }

    struct bpf_program *prog = bpf_object__find_program_by_name(obj, "spotnik_xdp_filter");
    int prog_fd = bpf_program__fd(prog);

    /* 7. Attach XDP program to network interface hook */
    if (bpf_xdp_attach(ifindex, prog_fd, XDP_FLAGS_UPDATE_IF_NOEXIST, NULL) < 0) {
        perror("bpf_xdp_attach failed");
        return 1;
    }

    /* 8. Insert AF_XDP socket FD into xsks_map keyed by RX queue index */
    struct bpf_map *xsks_map = bpf_object__find_map_by_name(obj, "xsks_map");
    int map_fd = bpf_map__fd(xsks_map);

    if (bpf_map_update_elem(map_fd, &queue_id, &xsk_fd, BPF_ANY) < 0) {
        perror("bpf_map_update_elem failed");
        return 1;
    }

    printf("Spotnik AF_XDP filter active on %s (Queue %u -> Socket FD %d)\n",
           ifname, queue_id, xsk_fd);

    /* Main processing loop / suspend wait */
    pause();

    /* Clean exit and detachment */
    bpf_xdp_detach(ifindex, 0, NULL);
    bpf_object__close(obj);
    close(xsk_fd);
    munmap(bufs, UMEM_SIZE);

    return 0;
}

```

---

**Compilation & Execution**

```bash
# Compile eBPF kernel object
clang -O2 -g -target bpf -c spotnik_xdp_kern.c -o spotnik_xdp_kern.o

# Compile user space loader application
gcc -O2 spotnik_xdp_user.c -o spotnik_xdp_user -lbpf

# Run with interface argument (e.g., eth0)
sudo ./spotnik_xdp_user eth0

```
### Component 1: Wayland Backend Header (`aurora_wayland_backend.hpp`)

This header defines the `WaylandBackend` lifecycle manager, tracking `wl_surface` state mappings, `wl_seat` client inputs, and integrating commit callbacks directly into the `AuroraCompositor` event loop.

```cpp
#ifndef AURORA_WAYLAND_BACKEND_HPP
#define AURORA_WAYLAND_BACKEND_HPP

#include "aurora_desktop.hpp"
#include <wayland-server-core.h>
#include <wayland-server-protocol.h>
#include <memory>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace aurora::wayland {

struct WaylandSurface {
    struct wl_resource* resource{nullptr};
    struct wl_resource* pending_buffer{nullptr};
    int32_t buffer_damage_x{0};
    int32_t buffer_damage_y{0};
    uint32_t buffer_width{0};
    uint32_t buffer_height{0};
    uint64_t aurora_window_id{0};
    bool committed{false};
};

struct WaylandSeat {
    struct wl_resource* seat_resource{nullptr};
    struct wl_resource* pointer_resource{nullptr};
    struct wl_resource* keyboard_resource{nullptr};
    struct wl_resource* focused_surface_resource{nullptr};
    uint32_t pointer_serial{0};
    uint32_t keyboard_serial{0};
};

class WaylandBackend {
public:
    explicit WaylandBackend(std::shared_ptr<aurora::desktop::AuroraCompositor> compositor);
    ~WaylandBackend();

    WaylandBackend(const WaylandBackend&) = delete;
    WaylandBackend& operator=(const WaylandBackend&) = delete;

    bool initialize(const char* socket_name = nullptr);
    void dispatch_events(int timeout_ms = 0);

    // Client Surface Commit Interface
    void handle_surface_commit(WaylandSurface* surface);
    
    // Input Focus Pipeline
    void set_pointer_focus(uint64_t window_id, int32_t surface_x, int32_t surface_y);
    void set_keyboard_focus(uint64_t window_id);
    void send_key_event(uint32_t key, uint32_t state);

    [[nodiscard]] struct wl_display* get_display() const noexcept { return display_; }

private:
    void register_globals();

    std::shared_ptr<aurora::desktop::AuroraCompositor> compositor_;
    struct wl_display* display_{nullptr};
    struct wl_event_loop* event_loop_{nullptr};
    
    struct wl_global* compositor_global_{nullptr};
    struct wl_global* seat_global_{nullptr};

    std::unordered_map<struct wl_resource*, std::unique_ptr<WaylandSurface>> surfaces_;
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, WaylandSurface*> window_surface_map_;
    WaylandSeat seat_{};

    // Low-level Wayland Protocol Implementation Tables
    static const struct wl_compositor_interface compositor_implementation_;
    static const struct wl_surface_interface surface_implementation_;
    static const struct wl_seat_interface seat_implementation_;
};

} // namespace aurora::wayland

#endif // AURORA_WAYLAND_BACKEND_HPP

```

---

### Component 2: Wayland Backend Implementation (`aurora_wayland_backend.cpp`)

```cpp
#include "aurora_wayland_backend.hpp"
#include <iostream>
#include <cstring>
#include <sys/socket.h>

namespace aurora::wayland {

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Surface Protocol Dispatchers
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

static void wl_surface_destroy_handler(struct wl_client* client, struct wl_resource* resource) {
    (void)client;
    wl_resource_destroy(resource);
}

static void wl_surface_attach_handler(struct wl_client* client, struct wl_resource* resource,
                                      struct wl_resource* buffer_resource, int32_t x, int32_t y) {
    (void)client; (void)x; (void)y;
    auto* surface = static_cast<WaylandSurface*>(wl_resource_get_user_data(resource));
    if (surface) {
        surface->pending_buffer = buffer_resource;
    }
}

static void wl_surface_damage_handler(struct wl_client* client, struct wl_resource* resource,
                                      int32_t x, int32_t y, int32_t width, int32_t height) {
    (void)client;
    auto* surface = static_cast<WaylandSurface*>(wl_resource_get_user_data(resource));
    if (surface) {
        surface->buffer_damage_x = x;
        surface->buffer_damage_y = y;
        surface->buffer_width = static_cast<uint32_t>(width);
        surface->buffer_height = static_cast<uint32_t>(height);
    }
}

static void wl_surface_commit_handler(struct wl_client* client, struct wl_resource* resource) {
    (void)client;
    auto* backend = static_cast<WaylandBackend*>(wl_resource_get_user_data(resource));
    auto* surface = static_cast<WaylandSurface*>(wl_resource_get_user_data(resource));
    
    if (surface && backend) {
        backend->handle_surface_commit(surface);
    }
}

const struct wl_surface_interface WaylandBackend::surface_implementation_ = {
    .destroy = wl_surface_destroy_handler,
    .attach  = wl_surface_attach_handler,
    .damage  = wl_surface_damage_handler,
    .frame   = nullptr,
    .set_opaque_region = nullptr,
    .set_input_region = nullptr,
    .commit  = wl_surface_commit_handler,
    .set_buffer_transform = nullptr,
    .set_buffer_scale = nullptr,
    .damage_buffer = nullptr
};

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Compositor Global Interface
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

static void wl_compositor_create_surface(struct wl_client* client, struct wl_resource* resource,
                                         uint32_t id) {
    auto* backend = static_cast<WaylandBackend*>(wl_resource_get_user_data(resource));
    
    struct wl_resource* surface_resource = wl_resource_create(
        client, &wl_surface_interface, wl_resource_get_version(resource), id
    );

    auto surface = std::make_unique<WaylandSurface>();
    surface->resource = surface_resource;

    /* Associate user data pointers */
    wl_resource_set_implementation(
        surface_resource,
        &WaylandBackend::surface_implementation_,
        backend,
        [](struct wl_resource* res) {
            auto* surf = static_cast<WaylandSurface*>(wl_resource_get_user_data(res));
            delete surf;
        }
    );

    wl_resource_set_user_data(surface_resource, surface.get());
    (void)backend;
}

const struct wl_compositor_interface WaylandBackend::compositor_implementation_ = {
    .create_surface = wl_compositor_create_surface,
    .create_region  = nullptr
};

static void bind_compositor_global(struct wl_client* client, void* data, uint32_t version, uint32_t id) {
    struct wl_resource* resource = wl_resource_create(client, &wl_compositor_interface, version, id);
    wl_resource_set_implementation(resource, &WaylandBackend::compositor_implementation_, data, nullptr);
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Seat Interface (Pointer & Keyboard Routing)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

static void wl_seat_get_pointer(struct wl_client* client, struct wl_resource* resource, uint32_t id) {
    struct wl_resource* pointer_res = wl_resource_create(client, &wl_pointer_interface, wl_resource_get_version(resource), id);
    (void)pointer_res;
}

static void wl_seat_get_keyboard(struct wl_client* client, struct wl_resource* resource, uint32_t id) {
    struct wl_resource* kb_res = wl_resource_create(client, &wl_keyboard_interface, wl_resource_get_version(resource), id);
    (void)kb_res;
}

const struct wl_seat_interface WaylandBackend::seat_implementation_ = {
    .get_pointer  = wl_seat_get_pointer,
    .get_keyboard = wl_seat_get_keyboard,
    .get_touch    = nullptr,
    .release      = nullptr
};

static void bind_seat_global(struct wl_client* client, void* data, uint32_t version, uint32_t id) {
    struct wl_resource* resource = wl_resource_create(client, &wl_seat_interface, version, id);
    wl_resource_set_implementation(resource, &WaylandBackend::seat_implementation_, data, nullptr);
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Backend Lifecycle & Implementation
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

WaylandBackend::WaylandBackend(std::shared_ptr<aurora::desktop::AuroraCompositor> compositor)
    : compositor_(std::move(compositor)) {}

WaylandBackend::~WaylandBackend() {
    if (compositor_global_) wl_global_destroy(compositor_global_);
    if (seat_global_) wl_global_destroy(seat_global_);
    if (display_) {
        wl_display_destroy_clients(display_);
        wl_display_destroy(display_);
    }
}

bool WaylandBackend::initialize(const char* socket_name) {
    display_ = wl_display_create();
    if (!display_) {
        std::cerr << "[Aurora Wayland] Failed to create Wayland display\n";
        return false;
    }

    event_loop_ = wl_display_get_event_loop(display_);
    register_globals();

    const char* socket = wl_display_add_socket_auto(display_);
    if (!socket) {
        std::cerr << "[Aurora Wayland] Failed to bind IPC socket\n";
        return false;
    }

    std::cout << "[Aurora Wayland] Server active on Wayland display socket: " << socket << "\n";
    return true;
}

void WaylandBackend::register_globals() {
    compositor_global_ = wl_global_create(display_, &wl_compositor_interface, 4, this, bind_compositor_global);
    seat_global_       = wl_global_create(display_, &wl_seat_interface, 7, this, bind_seat_global);
}

void WaylandBackend::dispatch_events(int timeout_ms) {
    wl_event_loop_dispatch(event_loop_, timeout_ms);
    wl_display_flush_clients(display_);
}

void WaylandBackend::handle_surface_commit(WaylandSurface* surface) {
    if (!surface) return;

    /* Assign window entity in compositor on first commit */
    if (surface->aurora_window_id == 0) {
        aurora::desktop::Rect initial_bounds{100, 100, 800, 600};
        surface->aurora_window_id = compositor_->create_window("Wayland Client", initial_bounds);
        window_surface_map_[surface->aurora_window_id] = surface;
    }

    /* Bind pending DMA buffer frame to Aurora surface buffer */
    if (surface->pending_buffer) {
        aurora::desktop::SurfaceBuffer buf{};
        buf.buffer_id = wl_resource_get_id(surface->pending_buffer);
        buf.width = surface->buffer_width;
        buf.height = surface->buffer_height;
        
        // Link surface buffer to window instance
        surface->committed = true;
    }

    compositor_->render_frame();
}

void WaylandBackend::set_pointer_focus(uint64_t window_id, int32_t surface_x, int32_t surface_y) {
    auto it = window_surface_map_.find(window_id);
    if (it == window_surface_map_.end() || !seat_.pointer_resource) return;

    WaylandSurface* target_surface = it->second;
    uint32_t serial = wl_display_next_serial(display_);

    /* Notify old focus of exit */
    if (seat_.focused_surface_resource && seat_.focused_surface_resource != target_surface->resource) {
        wl_pointer_send_leave(seat_.pointer_resource, serial, seat_.focused_surface_resource);
    }

    /* Send enter event to new client target */
    wl_fixed_t sx = wl_fixed_from_int(surface_x);
    wl_fixed_t sy = wl_fixed_from_int(surface_y);
    
    wl_pointer_send_enter(seat_.pointer_resource, serial, target_surface->resource, sx, sy);
    seat_.focused_surface_resource = target_surface->resource;
    seat_.pointer_serial = serial;

    compositor_->focus_window(window_id);
}

void WaylandBackend::set_keyboard_focus(uint64_t window_id) {
    auto it = window_surface_map_.find(window_id);
    if (it == window_surface_map_.end() || !seat_.keyboard_resource) return;

    WaylandSurface* target_surface = it->second;
    uint32_t serial = wl_display_next_serial(display_);

    struct wl_array keys;
    wl_array_init(&keys);

    if (seat_.focused_surface_resource && seat_.focused_surface_resource != target_surface->resource) {
        wl_keyboard_send_leave(seat_.keyboard_resource, serial, seat_.focused_surface_resource);
    }

    wl_keyboard_send_enter(seat_.keyboard_resource, serial, target_surface->resource, &keys);
    seat_.keyboard_serial = serial;
    
    wl_array_release(&keys);
}

void WaylandBackend::send_key_event(uint32_t key, uint32_t state) {
    if (!seat_.keyboard_resource) return;

    uint32_t serial = wl_display_next_serial(display_);
    uint32_t time_ms = 0; // Timestamp from Kernel Kore event dispatcher

    wl_keyboard_send_key(seat_.keyboard_resource, serial, time_ms, key, state);
}

} // namespace aurora::wayland

```

---

### Component Compilation

| File | Target Object | Linker Flags |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aurora_wayland_backend.cpp` | `aurora_wayland_backend.o` | `g++ -std=c++20 -O3 -Wall aurora_wayland_backend.cpp -c -lwayland-server` |

### Component 1: Wayland Backend Header (`aurora_wayland_backend.hpp`)

```cpp
    compositor_->render_frame();
}

void WaylandBackend::set_pointer_focus(uint64_t window_id, int32_t surface_x, int32_t surface_y) {
    auto it = window_surface_map_.find(window_id);
    if (it == window_surface_map_.end() || !seat_.pointer_resource) return;

    WaylandSurface* target_surface = it->second;
    uint32_t serial = wl_display_next_serial(display_);

    /* Notify old focus of exit */
    if (seat_.focused_surface_resource && seat_.focused_surface_resource != target_surface->resource) {
        wl_pointer_send_leave(seat_.pointer_resource, serial, seat_.focused_surface_resource);
    }

    /* Send enter event to new client target */
    wl_fixed_t sx = wl_fixed_from_int(surface_x);
    wl_fixed_t sy = wl_fixed_from_int(surface_y);
    
    wl_pointer_send_enter(seat_.pointer_resource, serial, target_surface->resource, sx, sy);
    seat_.focused_surface_resource = target_surface->resource;
    seat_.pointer_serial = serial;

    compositor_->focus_window(window_id);
}

void WaylandBackend::set_keyboard_focus(uint64_t window_id) {
    auto it = window_surface_map_.find(window_id);
    if (it == window_surface_map_.end() || !seat_.keyboard_resource) return;

    WaylandSurface* target_surface = it->second;
    uint32_t serial = wl_display_next_serial(display_);

    struct wl_array keys;
    wl_array_init(&keys);

    if (seat_.focused_surface_resource && seat_.focused_surface_resource != target_surface->resource) {
        wl_keyboard_send_leave(seat_.keyboard_resource, serial, seat_.focused_surface_resource);
    }

    wl_keyboard_send_enter(seat_.keyboard_resource, serial, target_surface->resource, &keys);
    seat_.keyboard_serial = serial;
    
    wl_array_release(&keys);
}

void WaylandBackend::send_key_event(uint32_t key, uint32_t state) {
    if (!seat_.keyboard_resource) return;

    uint32_t serial = wl_display_next_serial(display_);
    uint32_t time_ms = 0; // Timestamp from Kernel Kore event dispatcher

    wl_keyboard_send_key(seat_.keyboard_resource, serial, time_ms, key, state);
}

} // namespace aurora::wayland

```

---

### Component Compilation

| File | Target Object | Linker Flags |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aurora_wayland_backend.cpp` | `aurora_wayland_backend.o` | `g++ -std=c++20 -O3 -Wall aurora_wayland_backend.cpp -c -lwayland-server` |

This zero-copy Vulkan compositor module imports `dma-buf` file descriptors directly exported from Wayland client buffers (`zwp_linux_dmabuf_v1`) into `VkImage` textures without host or GPU buffer copies.

---

### Component 1: Vulkan Compositor Header (`aurora_vulkan_compositor.hpp`)

```cpp
#ifndef AURORA_VULKAN_COMPOSITOR_HPP
#define AURORA_VULKAN_COMPOSITOR_HPP

#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
#include <vulkan/vulkan_core.h>
#include <drm_fourcc.h>
#include <vector>
#include <memory>
#include <cstdint>

namespace aurora::gfx {

struct DmaBufPlane {
    int fd{-1};
    uint32_t offset{0};
    uint32_t stride{0};
};

struct DmaBufBuffer {
    uint32_t width{0};
    uint32_t height{0};
    uint32_t format{0}; // DRM fourcc format
    uint64_t modifier{DRM_FORMAT_MOD_INVALID};
    uint32_t plane_count{1};
    DmaBufPlane planes[4];
};

struct VulkanImportedTexture {
    VkImage image{VK_NULL_HANDLE};
    VkDeviceMemory memory{VK_NULL_HANDLE};
    VkImageView image_view{VK_NULL_HANDLE};
    VkDescriptorSet descriptor_set{VK_NULL_HANDLE};
    uint32_t width{0};
    uint32_t height{0};
};

class VulkanCompositor {
public:
    VulkanCompositor(VkInstance instance, VkPhysicalDevice physical_device, VkDevice device, uint32_t queue_family_index);
    ~VulkanCompositor();

    VulkanCompositor(const VulkanCompositor&) = delete;
    VulkanCompositor& operator=(const VulkanCompositor&) = delete;

    bool initialize();
    
    // Imports Linux dma-buf into a VkImage zero-copy backing surface
    std::unique_ptr<VulkanImportedTexture> import_dmabuf(const DmaBufBuffer& buffer);
    void destroy_texture(std::unique_ptr<VulkanImportedTexture> texture);

private:
    VkFormat drm_format_to_vulkan(uint32_t drm_format) const;
    uint32_t find_memory_type(uint32_t type_filter, VkMemoryPropertyFlags properties) const;

    VkInstance instance_{VK_NULL_HANDLE};
    VkPhysicalDevice physical_device_{VK_NULL_HANDLE};
    VkDevice device_{VK_NULL_HANDLE};
    uint32_t queue_family_{0};

    // Extension PFNs
    PFN_vkGetMemoryFdPropertiesKHR vkGetMemoryFdPropertiesKHR_{nullptr};
};

} // namespace aurora::gfx

#endif // AURORA_VULKAN_COMPOSITOR_HPP

```

---

### Component 2: Vulkan Compositor Implementation (`aurora_vulkan_compositor.cpp`)

```cpp
#include "aurora_vulkan_compositor.hpp"
#include <iostream>
#include <unistd.h>

namespace aurora::gfx {

VulkanCompositor::VulkanCompositor(VkInstance instance, VkPhysicalDevice physical_device, VkDevice device, uint32_t queue_family_index)
    : instance_(instance), physical_device_(physical_device), device_(device), queue_family_(queue_family_index) {}

VulkanCompositor::~VulkanCompositor() = default;

bool VulkanCompositor::initialize() {
    vkGetMemoryFdPropertiesKHR_ = reinterpret_cast<PFN_vkGetMemoryFdPropertiesKHR>(
        vkGetInstanceProcAddr(instance_, "vkGetMemoryFdPropertiesKHR"));

    if (!vkGetMemoryFdPropertiesKHR_) {
        std::cerr << "[Aurora GFX] Failed to load VK_KHR_external_memory_fd extension functions.\n";
        return false;
    }

    std::cout << "[Aurora GFX] Vulkan DMA-BUF zero-copy pipeline initialized successfully.\n";
    return true;
}

VkFormat VulkanCompositor::drm_format_to_vulkan(uint32_t drm_format) const {
    switch (drm_format) {
        case DRM_FORMAT_ARGB8888: return VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;
        case DRM_FORMAT_XRGB8888: return VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;
        case DRM_FORMAT_ABGR8888: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
        case DRM_FORMAT_XBGR8888: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
        case DRM_FORMAT_RGB565:   return VK_FORMAT_R5G6B5_UNORM_PACK16;
        default:                  return VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
    }
}

uint32_t VulkanCompositor::find_memory_type(uint32_t type_filter, VkMemoryPropertyFlags properties) const {
    VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties mem_props;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(physical_device_, &mem_props);

    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mem_props.memoryTypeCount; ++i) {
        if ((type_filter & (1 << i)) && (mem_props.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags & properties) == properties) {
            return i;
        }
    }
    return UINT32_MAX;
}

std::unique_ptr<VulkanImportedTexture> VulkanCompositor::import_dmabuf(const DmaBufBuffer& buffer) {
    VkFormat vk_format = drm_format_to_vulkan(buffer.format);
    if (vk_format == VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED) {
        std::cerr << "[Aurora GFX] Unsupported DRM FourCC format: " << buffer.format << "\n";
        return nullptr;
    }

    auto texture = std::make_unique<VulkanImportedTexture>();
    texture->width = buffer.width;
    texture->height = buffer.height;

    // 1. Setup External Memory Image Creation Info
    VkExternalMemoryImageCreateInfo external_img_info{};
    external_img_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO;
    external_img_info.handleTypes = VK_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_HANDLE_TYPE_DMA_BUF_BIT_EXT;

    // 2. Setup DRM Format Modifier Explicit Config
    VkSubresourceLayout plane_layouts[4]{};
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < buffer.plane_count; ++i) {
        plane_layouts[i].offset = buffer.planes[i].offset;
        plane_layouts[i].rowPitch = buffer.planes[i].stride;
        plane_layouts[i].size = buffer.planes[i].stride * buffer.height;
    }

    VkImageDrmFormatModifierExplicitCreateInfoEXT modifier_info{};
    modifier_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_DRM_FORMAT_MODIFIER_EXPLICIT_CREATE_INFO_EXT;
    modifier_info.pNext = &external_img_info;
    modifier_info.drmFormatModifier = buffer.modifier;
    modifier_info.drmFormatModifierPlaneCount = buffer.plane_count;
    modifier_info.pPlaneLayouts = plane_layouts;

    VkImageCreateInfo img_info{};
    img_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO;
    img_info.pNext = (buffer.modifier != DRM_FORMAT_MOD_INVALID) ? &modifier_info : (void*)&external_img_info;
    img_info.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
    img_info.format = vk_format;
    img_info.extent = { buffer.width, buffer.height, 1 };
    img_info.mipLevels = 1;
    img_info.arrayLayers = 1;
    img_info.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    img_info.tiling = (buffer.modifier != DRM_FORMAT_MOD_INVALID) ? VK_IMAGE_TILING_DRM_FORMAT_MODIFIER_EXT : VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
    img_info.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT;
    img_info.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
    img_info.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;

    if (vkCreateImage(device_, &img_info, nullptr, &texture->image) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        std::cerr << "[Aurora GFX] Failed to create VkImage for DMA-BUF import.\n";
        return nullptr;
    }

    // 3. Query Memory Requirements & Import DMA-BUF FD
    VkMemoryFdPropertiesKHR fd_props{};
    fd_props.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_FD_PROPERTIES_KHR;
    if (vkGetMemoryFdPropertiesKHR_(device_, VK_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_HANDLE_TYPE_DMA_BUF_BIT_EXT, buffer.planes[0].fd, &fd_props) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        std::cerr << "[Aurora GFX] Failed to retrieve DMA-BUF FD properties.\n";
        vkDestroyImage(device_, texture->image, nullptr);
        return nullptr;
    }

    VkMemoryRequirements mem_reqs;
    vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(device_, texture->image, &mem_reqs);

    VkImportMemoryFdInfoKHR import_fd_info{};
    import_fd_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMPORT_MEMORY_FD_INFO_KHR;
    import_fd_info.handleType = VK_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_HANDLE_TYPE_DMA_BUF_BIT_EXT;
    import_fd_info.fd = dup(buffer.planes[0].fd); // Duplicate FD as Vulkan takes ownership

    VkMemoryAllocateInfo alloc_info{};
    alloc_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO;
    alloc_info.pNext = &import_fd_info;
    alloc_info.allocationSize = mem_reqs.size;
    alloc_info.memoryTypeIndex = find_memory_type(mem_reqs.memoryTypeBits & fd_props.memoryTypeBits, 0);

    if (vkAllocateMemory(device_, &alloc_info, nullptr, &texture->memory) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        std::cerr << "[Aurora GFX] Failed to bind memory allocation for DMA-BUF.\n";
        close(import_fd_info.fd);
        vkDestroyImage(device_, texture->image, nullptr);
        return nullptr;
    }

    vkBindImageMemory(device_, texture->image, texture->memory, 0);

    // 4. Create Image View for Compositor Sampler
    VkImageViewCreateInfo view_info{};
    view_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO;
    view_info.image = texture->image;
    view_info.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
    view_info.format = vk_format;
    view_info.subresourceRange.aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
    view_info.subresourceRange.baseMipLevel = 0;
    view_info.subresourceRange.levelCount = 1;
    view_info.subresourceRange.baseArrayLayer = 0;
    view_info.subresourceRange.layerCount = 1;

    if (vkCreateImageView(device_, &view_info, nullptr, &texture->image_view) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        vkFreeMemory(device_, texture->memory, nullptr);
        vkDestroyImage(device_, texture->image, nullptr);
        return nullptr;
    }

    return texture;
}

void VulkanCompositor::destroy_texture(std::unique_ptr<VulkanImportedTexture> texture) {
    if (!texture) return;
    if (texture->image_view) vkDestroyImageView(device_, texture->image_view, nullptr);
    if (texture->image) vkDestroyImage(device_, texture->image, nullptr);
    if (texture->memory) vkFreeMemory(device_, texture->memory, nullptr);
}

} // namespace aurora::gfx

```

---

### Compilation Command

```bash
g++ -std=c++20 -O3 -Wall \
    aurora_vulkan_compositor.cpp -c -o aurora_vulkan_compositor.o \
    -lvulkan

```

This module implements the Vulkan render pass, graphics pipeline, descriptor layouts, bilinear sampler, and command buffer recording loop to draw zero-copy Wayland client windows as textured screen quads using push constants.

---

### Component 1: Quad Renderer Header (`aurora_vulkan_renderer.hpp`)

```cpp
#ifndef AURORA_VULKAN_RENDERER_HPP
#define AURORA_VULKAN_RENDERER_HPP

#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
#include <vector>
#include <memory>
#include <cstdint>

namespace aurora::gfx {

struct WindowPushConstants {
    float x;        // Normalized X [-1, 1]
    float y;        // Normalized Y [-1, 1]
    float width;    // Normalized Width [0, 2]
    float height;   // Normalized Height [0, 2]
    float opacity;  // Alpha transparency [0.0, 1.0]
    uint32_t pad[3];
};

struct WindowRenderData {
    VkDescriptorSet descriptor_set{VK_NULL_HANDLE}; // Bound to zero-copy VkImageView
    float x{0.0f};      // Pixel X position
    float y{0.0f};      // Pixel Y position
    float width{0.0f};  // Pixel Width
    float height{0.0f}; // Pixel Height
    float opacity{1.0f};
};

class VulkanQuadRenderer {
public:
    VulkanQuadRenderer(VkDevice device, VkFormat color_format);
    ~VulkanQuadRenderer();

    VulkanQuadRenderer(const VulkanQuadRenderer&) = delete;
    VulkanQuadRenderer& operator=(const VulkanQuadRenderer&) = delete;

    bool initialize(const uint32_t* vert_spirv, size_t vert_size,
                    const uint32_t* frag_spirv, size_t frag_size);
    
    VkDescriptorSet create_descriptor_set(VkDescriptorPool pool, VkImageView image_view);
    
    void record_render_pass(VkCommandBuffer cmd,
                           VkFramebuffer framebuffer,
                           VkExtent2D render_extent,
                           const std::vector<WindowRenderData>& windows);

    VkRenderPass get_render_pass() const { return render_pass_; }

private:
    bool create_render_pass();
    bool create_sampler_and_descriptor_layout();
    bool create_pipeline(const uint32_t* vert_spirv, size_t vert_size,
                         const uint32_t* frag_spirv, size_t frag_size);
    VkShaderModule create_shader_module(const uint32_t* code, size_t size);

    VkDevice device_{VK_NULL_HANDLE};
    VkFormat color_format_{VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM};

    VkRenderPass render_pass_{VK_NULL_HANDLE};
    VkSampler sampler_{VK_NULL_HANDLE};
    VkDescriptorSetLayout descriptor_set_layout_{VK_NULL_HANDLE};
    VkPipelineLayout pipeline_layout_{VK_NULL_HANDLE};
    VkPipeline pipeline_{VK_NULL_HANDLE};
};

} // namespace aurora::gfx

#endif // AURORA_VULKAN_RENDERER_HPP

```

---

### Component 2: Quad Renderer Implementation (`aurora_vulkan_renderer.cpp`)

```cpp
#include "aurora_vulkan_renderer.hpp"
#include <iostream>

namespace aurora::gfx {

VulkanQuadRenderer::VulkanQuadRenderer(VkDevice device, VkFormat color_format)
    : device_(device), color_format_(color_format) {}

VulkanQuadRenderer::~VulkanQuadRenderer() {
    if (pipeline_) vkDestroyPipeline(device_, pipeline_, nullptr);
    if (pipeline_layout_) vkDestroyPipelineLayout(device_, pipeline_layout_, nullptr);
    if (descriptor_set_layout_) vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout(device_, descriptor_set_layout_, nullptr);
    if (sampler_) vkDestroySampler(device_, sampler_, nullptr);
    if (render_pass_) vkDestroyRenderPass(device_, render_pass_, nullptr);
}

bool VulkanQuadRenderer::initialize(const uint32_t* vert_spirv, size_t vert_size,
                                     const uint32_t* frag_spirv, size_t frag_size) {
    if (!create_render_pass()) return false;
    if (!create_sampler_and_descriptor_layout()) return false;
    if (!create_pipeline(vert_spirv, vert_size, frag_spirv, frag_size)) return false;

    std::cout << "[Aurora GFX] Vulkan Quad Renderer pipeline initialized successfully.\n";
    return true;
}

bool VulkanQuadRenderer::create_render_pass() {
    VkAttachmentDescription color_attachment{};
    color_attachment.format = color_format_;
    color_attachment.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    color_attachment.loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_CLEAR;
    color_attachment.storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE;
    color_attachment.stencilLoadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_DONT_CARE;
    color_attachment.stencilStoreOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_DONT_CARE;
    color_attachment.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    color_attachment.finalLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR;

    VkAttachmentReference color_attachment_ref{};
    color_attachment_ref.attachment = 0;
    color_attachment_ref.layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;

    VkSubpassDescription subpass{};
    subpass.pipelineBindPoint = VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS;
    subpass.colorAttachmentCount = 1;
    subpass.pColorAttachments = &color_attachment_ref;

    VkSubpassDependency dependency{};
    dependency.srcSubpass = VK_SUBPASS_EXTERNAL;
    dependency.dstSubpass = 0;
    dependency.srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
    dependency.srcAccessMask = 0;
    dependency.dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
    dependency.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;

    VkRenderPassCreateInfo render_pass_info{};
    render_pass_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_CREATE_INFO;
    render_pass_info.attachmentCount = 1;
    render_pass_info.pAttachments = &color_attachment;
    render_pass_info.subpassCount = 1;
    render_pass_info.pSubpasses = &subpass;
    render_pass_info.dependencyCount = 1;
    render_pass_info.pDependencies = &dependency;

    return vkCreateRenderPass(device_, &render_pass_info, nullptr, &render_pass_) == VK_SUCCESS;
}

bool VulkanQuadRenderer::create_sampler_and_descriptor_layout() {
    // Linear Bilinear Sampler
    VkSamplerCreateInfo sampler_info{};
    sampler_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SAMPLER_CREATE_INFO;
    sampler_info.magFilter = VK_FILTER_LINEAR;
    sampler_info.minFilter = VK_FILTER_LINEAR;
    sampler_info.addressModeU = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE;
    sampler_info.addressModeV = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE;
    sampler_info.addressModeW = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE;
    sampler_info.mipmapMode = VK_SAMPLER_MIPMAP_MODE_LINEAR;

    if (vkCreateSampler(device_, &sampler_info, nullptr, &sampler_) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        return false;
    }

    // Combined Image Sampler Layout (Binding 0)
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding sampler_layout_binding{};
    sampler_layout_binding.binding = 0;
    sampler_layout_binding.descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER;
    sampler_layout_binding.descriptorCount = 1;
    sampler_layout_binding.stageFlags = VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT;
    sampler_layout_binding.pImmutableSamplers = nullptr;

    VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo layout_info{};
    layout_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO;
    layout_info.bindingCount = 1;
    layout_info.pBindings = &sampler_layout_binding;

    return vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(device_, &layout_info, nullptr, &descriptor_set_layout_) == VK_SUCCESS;
}

VkDescriptorSet VulkanQuadRenderer::create_descriptor_set(VkDescriptorPool pool, VkImageView image_view) {
    VkDescriptorSet descriptor_set{VK_NULL_HANDLE};

    VkDescriptorSetAllocateInfo alloc_info{};
    alloc_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO;
    alloc_info.descriptorPool = pool;
    alloc_info.descriptorSetCount = 1;
    alloc_info.pSetLayouts = &descriptor_set_layout_;

    if (vkAllocateDescriptorSets(device_, &alloc_info, &descriptor_set) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }

    VkDescriptorImageInfo image_info{};
    image_info.imageLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL;
    image_info.imageView = image_view;
    image_info.sampler = sampler_;

    VkWriteDescriptorSet descriptor_write{};
    descriptor_write.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET;
    descriptor_write.dstSet = descriptor_set;
    descriptor_write.dstBinding = 0;
    descriptor_write.dstArrayElement = 0;
    descriptor_write.descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER;
    descriptor_write.descriptorCount = 1;
    descriptor_write.pImageInfo = &image_info;

    vkUpdateDescriptorSets(device_, 1, &descriptor_write, 0, nullptr);
    return descriptor_set;
}

bool VulkanQuadRenderer::create_pipeline(const uint32_t* vert_spirv, size_t vert_size,
                                           const uint32_t* frag_spirv, size_t frag_size) {
    VkShaderModule vert_module = create_shader_module(vert_spirv, vert_size);
    VkShaderModule frag_module = create_shader_module(frag_spirv, frag_size);

    if (!vert_module || !frag_module) return false;

    VkPipelineShaderStageCreateInfo vert_stage_info{};
    vert_stage_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO;
    vert_stage_info.stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT;
    vert_stage_info.module = vert_module;
    vert_stage_info.pName = "main";

    VkPipelineShaderStageCreateInfo frag_stage_info{};
    frag_stage_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO;
    frag_stage_info.stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT;
    frag_stage_info.module = frag_module;
    frag_stage_info.pName = "main";

    VkPipelineShaderStageCreateInfo shader_stages[] = { vert_stage_info, frag_stage_info };

    // Procedural Quad Geometry (No Vertex Input Binding)
    VkPipelineVertexInputStateCreateInfo vertex_input_info{};
    vertex_input_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_VERTEX_INPUT_STATE_CREATE_INFO;

    VkPipelineInputAssemblyStateCreateInfo input_assembly{};
    input_assembly.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_INPUT_ASSEMBLY_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    input_assembly.topology = VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST;

    VkPipelineViewportStateCreateInfo viewport_state{};
    viewport_state.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_VIEWPORT_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    viewport_state.viewportCount = 1;
    viewport_state.scissorCount = 1;

    VkPipelineRasterizationStateCreateInfo rasterizer{};
    rasterizer.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_RASTERIZATION_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    rasterizer.polygonMode = VK_POLYGON_MODE_FILL;
    rasterizer.cullMode = VK_CULL_MODE_NONE;
    rasterizer.frontFace = VK_FRONT_FACE_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE;
    rasterizer.lineWidth = 1.0f;

    VkPipelineMultisampleStateCreateInfo multisampling{};
    multisampling.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_MULTISAMPLE_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    multisampling.rasterizationSamples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;

    // Alpha Blending for Transparency / Popups
    VkPipelineColorBlendAttachmentState color_blend_attachment{};
    color_blend_attachment.blendEnable = VK_TRUE;
    color_blend_attachment.srcColorBlendFactor = VK_BLEND_FACTOR_SRC_ALPHA;
    color_blend_attachment.dstColorBlendFactor = VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA;
    color_blend_attachment.colorBlendOp = VK_BLEND_OP_ADD;
    color_blend_attachment.srcAlphaBlendFactor = VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE;
    color_blend_attachment.dstAlphaBlendFactor = VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ZERO;
    color_blend_attachment.alphaBlendOp = VK_BLEND_OP_ADD;
    color_blend_attachment.colorWriteMask = VK_COLOR_COMPONENT_R_BIT | VK_COLOR_COMPONENT_G_BIT |
                                             VK_COLOR_COMPONENT_B_BIT | VK_COLOR_COMPONENT_A_BIT;

    VkPipelineColorBlendStateCreateInfo color_blending{};
    color_blending.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_COLOR_BLEND_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    color_blending.attachmentCount = 1;
    color_blending.pAttachments = &color_blend_attachment;

    VkDynamicState dynamic_states[] = { VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_VIEWPORT, VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_SCISSOR };
    VkPipelineDynamicStateCreateInfo dynamic_state{};
    dynamic_state.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_DYNAMIC_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    dynamic_state.dynamicStateCount = 2;
    dynamic_state.pDynamicStates = dynamic_states;

    // Push Constants Layout
    VkPushConstantRange push_constant_range{};
    push_constant_range.stageFlags = VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT | VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT;
    push_constant_range.offset = 0;
    push_constant_range.size = sizeof(WindowPushConstants);

    VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo pipeline_layout_info{};
    pipeline_layout_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO;
    pipeline_layout_info.setLayoutCount = 1;
    pipeline_layout_info.pSetLayouts = &descriptor_set_layout_;
    pipeline_layout_info.pushConstantRangeCount = 1;
    pipeline_layout_info.pPushConstantRanges = &push_constant_range;

    if (vkCreatePipelineLayout(device_, &pipeline_layout_info, nullptr, &pipeline_layout_) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        vkDestroyShaderModule(device_, vert_module, nullptr);
        vkDestroyShaderModule(device_, frag_module, nullptr);
        return false;
    }

    VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo pipeline_info{};
    pipeline_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO;
    pipeline_info.stageCount = 2;
    pipeline_info.pStages = shader_stages;
    pipeline_info.pVertexInputState = &vertex_input_info;
    pipeline_info.pInputAssemblyState = &input_assembly;
    pipeline_info.pViewportState = &viewport_state;
    pipeline_info.pRasterizationState = &rasterizer;
    pipeline_info.pMultisampleState = &multisampling;
    pipeline_info.pColorBlendState = &color_blending;
    pipeline_info.pDynamicState = &dynamic_state;
    pipeline_info.layout = pipeline_layout_;
    pipeline_info.renderPass = render_pass_;
    pipeline_info.subpass = 0;

    VkResult res = vkCreateGraphicsPipelines(device_, VK_NULL_HANDLE, 1, &pipeline_info, nullptr, &pipeline_);

    vkDestroyShaderModule(device_, vert_module, nullptr);
    vkDestroyShaderModule(device_, frag_module, nullptr);

    return res == VK_SUCCESS;
}

VkShaderModule VulkanQuadRenderer::create_shader_module(const uint32_t* code, size_t size) {
    VkShaderModuleCreateInfo create_info{};
    create_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO;
    create_info.codeSize = size;
    create_info.pCode = code;

    VkShaderModule shader_module;
    if (vkCreateShaderModule(device_, &create_info, nullptr, &shader_module) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    return shader_module;
}

void VulkanQuadRenderer::record_render_pass(VkCommandBuffer cmd,
                                            VkFramebuffer framebuffer,
                                            VkExtent2D render_extent,
                                            const std::vector<WindowRenderData>& windows) {
    VkRenderPassBeginInfo render_pass_info{};
    render_pass_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_BEGIN_INFO;
    render_pass_info.renderPass = render_pass_;
    render_pass_info.framebuffer = framebuffer;
    render_pass_info.renderArea.offset = {0, 0};
    render_pass_info.renderArea.extent = render_extent;

    VkClearValue clear_color = {{{0.05f, 0.05f, 0.08f, 1.0f}}};
    render_pass_info.clearValueCount = 1;
    render_pass_info.pClearValues = &clear_color;

    vkCmdBeginRenderPass(cmd, &render_pass_info, VK_SUBPASS_CONTENTS_INLINE);
    vkCmdBindPipeline(cmd, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipeline_);

    VkViewport viewport{0.0f, 0.0f, static_cast<float>(render_extent.width), static_cast<float>(render_extent.height), 0.0f, 1.0f};
    VkRect2D scissor{{0, 0}, render_extent};
    vkCmdSetViewport(cmd, 0, 1, &viewport);
    vkCmdSetScissor(cmd, 0, 1, &scissor);

    float screen_w = static_cast<float>(render_extent.width);
    float screen_h = static_cast<float>(render_extent.height);

    for (const auto& win : windows) {
        if (!win.descriptor_set) continue;

        // Convert pixel coordinates to normalized device coordinates (NDC: [-1, 1])
        WindowPushConstants pc{};
        pc.x = (win.x / screen_w) * 2.0f - 1.0f;
        pc.y = (win.y / screen_h) * 2.0f - 1.0f;
        pc.width = (win.width / screen_w) * 2.0f;
        pc.height = (win.height / screen_h) * 2.0f;
        pc.opacity = win.opacity;

        vkCmdPushConstants(cmd, pipeline_layout_, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT | VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT,
                           0, sizeof(WindowPushConstants), &pc);

        vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(cmd, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipeline_layout_,
                                0, 1, &win.descriptor_set, 0, nullptr);

        // Draw 6 vertices (2 triangles procedural quad)
        vkCmdDraw(cmd, 6, 1, 0, 0);
    }

    vkCmdEndRenderPass(cmd);
}

} // namespace aurora::gfx

```

---

### Component 3: GLSL Quad Shaders

#### Vertex Shader (`quad.vert`)

```glsl
#version 450

layout(push_constant) uniform PushConstants {
    vec2 pos;
    vec2 size;
    float opacity;
} pc;

layout(location = 0) out vec2 outUV;

void main() {
    // 6-vertex procedural quad
    vec2 positions[6] = vec2[](
        vec2(0.0, 0.0), vec2(1.0, 0.0), vec2(0.0, 1.0),
        vec2(0.0, 1.0), vec2(1.0, 0.0), vec2(1.0, 1.0)
    );

    vec2 vertex_pos = positions[gl_VertexIndex];
    outUV = vertex_pos;

    vec2 ndc_pos = pc.pos + (vertex_pos * pc.size);
    gl_Position = vec4(ndc_pos, 0.0, 1.0);
}

```

#### Fragment Shader (`quad.frag`)

```glsl
#version 450

layout(location = 0) in vec2 inUV;
layout(location = 0) out vec4 outColor;

layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D texSampler;

layout(push_constant) uniform PushConstants {
    vec2 pos;
    vec2 size;
    float opacity;
} pc;

void main() {
    vec4 texColor = texture(texSampler, inUV);
    outColor = vec4(texColor.rgb, texColor.a * pc.opacity);
}

```

---

### Compilation Command

```bash
# 1. Compile GLSL Shaders to SPIR-V Bytecode
glslc quad.vert -o quad.vert.spv
glslc quad.frag -o quad.frag.spv

# 2. Compile C++ Renderer Implementation
g++ -std=c++20 -O3 -Wall \
    aurora_vulkan_renderer.cpp -c -o aurora_vulkan_renderer.o \
    -lvulkan

```

This module provides the implementation of the `linux-drm-syncobj-v1` Wayland protocol protocol interface, DRM timeline syncobj wrapping, and frame synchronization state tracking for explicit GPU-GPU sync in the Aurora compositor backend.

---

### Component 1: Protocol & Syncobj Header (`aurora_drm_syncobj.hpp`)

```cpp
#ifndef AURORA_DRM_SYNCOBJ_HPP
#define AURORA_DRM_SYNCOBJ_HPP

#include <wayland-server-core.h>
#include <xf86drm.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

// Generated protocol header from linux-drm-syncobj-v1.xml
#include "linux-drm-syncobj-v1-server-protocol.h"

namespace aurora::wayland {

class DrmSyncobjTimeline {
public:
    DrmSyncobjTimeline(int drm_fd, uint32_t handle);
    ~DrmSyncobjTimeline();

    DrmSyncobjTimeline(const DrmSyncobjTimeline&) = delete;
    DrmSyncobjTimeline& operator=(const DrmSyncobjTimeline&) = delete;

    static std::shared_ptr<DrmSyncobjTimeline> import_from_fd(int drm_fd, int fd);
    
    bool wait(uint64_t point, uint64_t timeout_ns);
    bool signal(uint64_t point);
    
    uint32_t get_handle() const { return handle_; }

private:
    int drm_fd_{-1};
    uint32_t handle_{0};
};

struct SyncPoint {
    std::shared_ptr<DrmSyncobjTimeline> timeline{nullptr};
    uint64_t point{0};

    bool is_valid() const { return timeline != nullptr; }
    void reset() { timeline.reset(); point = 0; }
};

struct SurfaceSyncState {
    SyncPoint pending_acquire;
    SyncPoint pending_release;

    SyncPoint current_acquire;
    SyncPoint current_release;

    void commit_pending() {
        current_acquire = pending_acquire;
        current_release = pending_release;
        pending_acquire.reset();
        pending_release.reset();
    }
};

class DrmSyncobjManager {
public:
    DrmSyncobjManager(wl_display* display, int drm_fd);
    ~DrmSyncobjManager();

    int get_drm_fd() const { return drm_fd_; }
    
    SurfaceSyncState* get_surface_state(wl_resource* surface_resource);
    void register_surface_state(wl_resource* surface_resource, SurfaceSyncState* state);
    void unregister_surface_state(wl_resource* surface_resource);

    // Compositor rendering sync interface
    bool wait_for_acquire_fence(wl_resource* surface_resource, uint64_t timeout_ns = 1000000000ULL);
    bool signal_release_fence(wl_resource* surface_resource);

private:
    static void bind_global(wl_client* client, void* data, uint32_t version, uint32_t id);
    
    wl_display* display_{nullptr};
    wl_global* global_{nullptr};
    int drm_fd_{-1};

    std::unordered_map<wl_resource*, SurfaceSyncState*> surface_states_;
};

} // namespace aurora::wayland

#endif // AURORA_DRM_SYNCOBJ_HPP

```

---

### Component 2: Implementation (`aurora_drm_syncobj.cpp`)

```cpp
#include "aurora_drm_syncobj.hpp"
#include <iostream>
#include <unistd.h>

namespace aurora::wayland {

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// DrmSyncobjTimeline
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

DrmSyncobjTimeline::DrmSyncobjTimeline(int drm_fd, uint32_t handle)
    : drm_fd_(drm_fd), handle_(handle) {}

DrmSyncobjTimeline::~DrmSyncobjTimeline() {
    if (handle_ != 0 && drm_fd_ >= 0) {
        drmSyncobjDestroy(drm_fd_, handle_);
    }
}

std::shared_ptr<DrmSyncobjTimeline> DrmSyncobjTimeline::import_from_fd(int drm_fd, int fd) {
    uint32_t handle = 0;
    int res = drmSyncobjFDToHandle(drm_fd, fd, &handle);
    close(fd); // FD ownership transferred to handle

    if (res != 0) {
        std::cerr << "[Aurora Syncobj] Failed to import syncobj handle from FD: " << res << "\n";
        return nullptr;
    }

    return std::make_shared<DrmSyncobjTimeline>(drm_fd, handle);
}

bool DrmSyncobjTimeline::wait(uint64_t point, uint64_t timeout_ns) {
    if (handle_ == 0 || drm_fd_ < 0) return false;

    uint32_t first_signaled = 0;
    int res = drmSyncobjTimelineWait(drm_fd_, &handle_, &point, 1, 
                                     static_cast<int64_t>(timeout_ns), 
                                     DRM_SYNCOBJ_WAIT_FLAGS_WAIT_ALL, 
                                     &first_signaled);
    return res == 0;
}

bool DrmSyncobjTimeline::signal(uint64_t point) {
    if (handle_ == 0 || drm_fd_ < 0) return false;

    int res = drmSyncobjTimelineSignal(drm_fd_, &handle_, &point, 1);
    return res == 0;
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Wayland Request Dispatchers
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

static void timeline_destroy(wl_client* client, wl_resource* resource) {
    wl_resource_destroy(resource);
}

static const struct wp_linux_drm_syncobj_timeline_v1_interface timeline_impl = {
    .destroy = timeline_destroy,
};

static void timeline_resource_destroy(wl_resource* resource) {
    auto* timeline_ptr = static_cast<std::shared_ptr<DrmSyncobjTimeline>*>(wl_resource_get_user_data(resource));
    delete timeline_ptr;
}

static void surface_sync_destroy(wl_client* client, wl_resource* resource) {
    wl_resource_destroy(resource);
}

static void surface_sync_set_acquire_point(wl_client* client, wl_resource* resource,
                                            wl_resource* timeline_res,
                                            uint32_t point_hi, uint32_t point_lo) {
    auto* state = static_cast<SurfaceSyncState*>(wl_resource_get_user_data(resource));
    auto* timeline_ptr = static_cast<std::shared_ptr<DrmSyncobjTimeline>*>(
        wl_resource_get_user_data(timeline_res));

    if (!state || !timeline_ptr || !(*timeline_ptr)) return;

    uint64_t point = (static_cast<uint64_t>(point_hi) << 32) | point_lo;
    state->pending_acquire = { *timeline_ptr, point };
}

static void surface_sync_set_release_point(wl_client* client, wl_resource* resource,
                                            wl_resource* timeline_res,
                                            uint32_t point_hi, uint32_t point_lo) {
    auto* state = static_cast<SurfaceSyncState*>(wl_resource_get_user_data(resource));
    auto* timeline_ptr = static_cast<std::shared_ptr<DrmSyncobjTimeline>*>(
        wl_resource_get_user_data(timeline_res));

    if (!state || !timeline_ptr || !(*timeline_ptr)) return;

    uint64_t point = (static_cast<uint64_t>(point_hi) << 32) | point_lo;
    state->pending_release = { *timeline_ptr, point };
}

static const struct wp_linux_drm_syncobj_surface_v1_interface surface_sync_impl = {
    .destroy = surface_sync_destroy,
    .set_acquire_point = surface_sync_set_acquire_point,
    .set_release_point = surface_sync_set_release_point,
};

static void surface_sync_resource_destroy(wl_resource* resource) {
    auto* state = static_cast<SurfaceSyncState*>(wl_resource_get_user_data(resource));
    delete state;
}

static void manager_destroy(wl_client* client, wl_resource* resource) {
    wl_resource_destroy(resource);
}

static void manager_get_surface(wl_client* client, wl_resource* resource,
                                 uint32_t id, wl_resource* surface_resource) {
    auto* manager = static_cast<DrmSyncobjManager*>(wl_resource_get_user_data(resource));
    
    auto* state = new SurfaceSyncState();
    wl_resource* sync_res = wl_resource_create(client, &wp_linux_drm_syncobj_surface_v1_interface,
                                               wl_resource_get_version(resource), id);

    wl_resource_set_implementation(sync_res, &surface_sync_impl, state, surface_sync_resource_destroy);
    manager->register_surface_state(surface_resource, state);
}

static void manager_import_timeline(wl_client* client, wl_resource* resource,
                                     uint32_t id, int32_t fd) {
    auto* manager = static_cast<DrmSyncobjManager*>(wl_resource_get_user_data(resource));

    auto timeline = DrmSyncobjTimeline::import_from_fd(manager->get_drm_fd(), fd);
    if (!timeline) {
        wl_resource_post_error(resource, WP_LINUX_DRM_SYNCOBJ_MANAGER_V1_ERROR_INVALID_TIMELINE,
                               "Failed to import DRM syncobj timeline handle");
        return;
    }

    wl_resource* timeline_res = wl_resource_create(client, &wp_linux_drm_syncobj_timeline_v1_interface,
                                                    wl_resource_get_version(resource), id);

    auto* holder = new std::shared_ptr<DrmSyncobjTimeline>(timeline);
    wl_resource_set_implementation(timeline_res, &timeline_impl, holder, timeline_resource_destroy);
}

static const struct wp_linux_drm_syncobj_manager_v1_interface manager_impl = {
    .destroy = manager_destroy,
    .get_surface = manager_get_surface,
    .import_timeline = manager_import_timeline,
};

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// DrmSyncobjManager
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

DrmSyncobjManager::DrmSyncobjManager(wl_display* display, int drm_fd)
    : display_(display), drm_fd_(drm_fd) {
    global_ = wl_global_create(display_, &wp_linux_drm_syncobj_manager_v1_interface,
                               1, this, DrmSyncobjManager::bind_global);
}

DrmSyncobjManager::~DrmSyncobjManager() {
    if (global_) wl_global_destroy(global_);
}

void DrmSyncobjManager::bind_global(wl_client* client, void* data, uint32_t version, uint32_t id) {
    wl_resource* resource = wl_resource_create(client, &wp_linux_drm_syncobj_manager_v1_interface, version, id);
    wl_resource_set_implementation(resource, &manager_impl, data, nullptr);
}

SurfaceSyncState* DrmSyncobjManager::get_surface_state(wl_resource* surface_resource) {
    auto it = surface_states_.find(surface_resource);
    return (it != surface_states_.end()) ? it->second : nullptr;
}

void DrmSyncobjManager::register_surface_state(wl_resource* surface_resource, SurfaceSyncState* state) {
    surface_states_[surface_resource] = state;
}

void DrmSyncobjManager::unregister_surface_state(wl_resource* surface_resource) {
    surface_states_.erase(surface_resource);
}

bool DrmSyncobjManager::wait_for_acquire_fence(wl_resource* surface_resource, uint64_t timeout_ns) {
    SurfaceSyncState* state = get_surface_state(surface_resource);
    if (!state || !state->current_acquire.is_valid()) {
        return true; // No explicit wait point specified
    }

    return state->current_acquire.timeline->wait(state->current_acquire.point, timeout_ns);
}

bool DrmSyncobjManager::signal_release_fence(wl_resource* surface_resource) {
    SurfaceSyncState* state = get_surface_state(surface_resource);
    if (!state || !state->current_release.is_valid()) {
        return true; // No explicit release point requested
    }

    return state->current_release.timeline->signal(state->current_release.point);
}

} // namespace aurora::wayland

```

---

### Integration: Linking Acquires and Releases in Output Loop

When `wl_surface.commit` is called by the client, commit the pending points in your compositor handler:

```cpp
void on_surface_commit(wl_resource* surface_resource) {
    aurora::wayland::SurfaceSyncState* state = syncobj_mgr->get_surface_state(surface_resource);
    if (state) {
        state->commit_pending();
    }
}

void render_frame_loop(wl_resource* surface_resource) {
    // 1. Wait for client's acquire timeline point before Vulkan reads the buffer
    syncobj_mgr->wait_for_acquire_fence(surface_resource);

    // 2. Submit composition draw commands via Vulkan command buffer
    // ...

    // 3. Signal client's release timeline point once GPU composition completes
    syncobj_mgr->signal_release_fence(surface_resource);
}

```

This module provides regional damage tracking, bounding box merging, screen clipping, and Vulkan dynamic scissor command buffer recording for partial updates in the Aurora compositor renderer.

---

### Component 1: Damage Region Header (`aurora_damage_tracker.hpp`)

```cpp
#ifndef AURORA_DAMAGE_TRACKER_HPP
#define AURORA_DAMAGE_TRACKER_HPP

#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>

namespace aurora::gfx {

struct Rect2D {
    int32_t x{0};
    int32_t y{0};
    uint32_t width{0};
    uint32_t height{0};

    bool empty() const { return width == 0 || height == 0; }
    
    // Returns true if two rectangles overlap
    bool intersects(const Rect2D& other) const {
        return (x < static_cast<int32_t>(other.x + other.width) &&
                static_cast<int32_t>(x + width) > other.x &&
                y < static_cast<int32_t>(other.y + other.height) &&
                static_cast<int32_t>(y + height) > other.y);
    }

    // Returns bounding box of two rectangles
    Rect2D unite(const Rect2D& other) const {
        if (empty()) return other;
        if (other.empty()) return *this;

        int32_t min_x = std::min(x, other.x);
        int32_t min_y = std::min(y, other.y);
        int32_t max_x = std::max(x + static_cast<int32_t>(width), other.x + static_cast<int32_t>(other.width));
        int32_t max_y = std::max(y + static_cast<int32_t>(height), other.y + static_cast<int32_t>(other.height));

        return {min_x, min_y, static_cast<uint32_t>(max_x - min_x), static_cast<uint32_t>(max_y - min_y)};
    }

    // Intersection with screen screen boundaries
    Rect2D clip(VkExtent2D screen) const {
        int32_t min_x = std::clamp(x, 0, static_cast<int32_t>(screen.width));
        int32_t min_y = std::clamp(y, 0, static_cast<int32_t>(screen.height));
        int32_t max_x = std::clamp(x + static_cast<int32_t>(width), 0, static_cast<int32_t>(screen.width));
        int32_t max_y = std::clamp(y + static_cast<int32_t>(height), 0, static_cast<int32_t>(screen.height));

        return {min_x, min_y, static_cast<uint32_t>(max_x - min_x), static_cast<uint32_t>(max_y - min_y)};
    }

    VkRect2D to_vk_rect() const {
        return {
            {x, y},
            {width, height}
        };
    }
};

class DamageTracker {
public:
    DamageTracker() = default;

    void add_damage(const Rect2D& rect);
    void add_surface_damage(float win_x, float win_y, const Rect2D& local_rect);
    void clear();

    bool has_damage() const { return !rects_.empty(); }
    
    // Calculates unified minimal bounding box covering all dirty regions
    Rect2D get_bounding_box(VkExtent2D screen_extent) const;

    // Coalesces overlapping rectangles to optimize scissor context switching
    std::vector<VkRect2D> get_optimized_scissors(VkExtent2D screen_extent) const;

private:
    std::vector<Rect2D> rects_;
};

} // namespace aurora::gfx

#endif // AURORA_DAMAGE_TRACKER_HPP

```

---

### Component 2: Damage Propagation Implementation (`aurora_damage_tracker.cpp`)

```cpp
#include "aurora_damage_tracker.hpp"

namespace aurora::gfx {

void DamageTracker::add_damage(const Rect2D& rect) {
    if (!rect.empty()) {
        rects_.push_back(rect);
    }
}

void DamageTracker::add_surface_damage(float win_x, float win_y, const Rect2D& local_rect) {
    if (local_rect.empty()) return;

    Rect2D global_rect{
        static_cast<int32_t>(win_x) + local_rect.x,
        static_cast<int32_t>(win_y) + local_rect.y,
        local_rect.width,
        local_rect.height
    };
    
    rects_.push_back(global_rect);
}

void DamageTracker::clear() {
    rects_.clear();
}

Rect2D DamageTracker::get_bounding_box(VkExtent2D screen_extent) const {
    Rect2D bbox{};
    for (const auto& rect : rects_) {
        bbox = bbox.unite(rect);
    }
    return bbox.clip(screen_extent);
}

std::vector<VkRect2D> DamageTracker::get_optimized_scissors(VkExtent2D screen_extent) const {
    if (rects_.empty()) return {};

    // 1. Clip all damage rects against display screen bounds
    std::vector<Rect2D> clipped;
    clipped.reserve(rects_.size());
    for (const auto& r : rects_) {
        Rect2D c = r.clip(screen_extent);
        if (!c.empty()) clipped.push_back(c);
    }

    if (clipped.empty()) return {};

    // 2. Coalesce adjacent and overlapping rects to reduce raster state overhead
    std::vector<Rect2D> merged;
    std::vector<bool> merged_mask(clipped.size(), false);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < clipped.size(); ++i) {
        if (merged_mask[i]) continue;

        Rect2D current = clipped[i];
        bool changed = true;

        while (changed) {
            changed = false;
            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < clipped.size(); ++j) {
                if (!merged_mask[j] && current.intersects(clipped[j])) {
                    current = current.unite(clipped[j]);
                    merged_mask[j] = true;
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
        }
        merged.push_back(current);
    }

    // 3. Convert to VkRect2D array
    std::vector<VkRect2D> result;
    result.reserve(merged.size());
    for (const auto& r : merged) {
        result.push_back(r.to_vk_rect());
    }

    return result;
}

} // namespace aurora::gfx

```

---

### Component 3: Damage-Aware Render Loop Integration (`aurora_damaged_render_pass.cpp`)

```cpp
#include "aurora_vulkan_renderer.hpp"
#include "aurora_damage_tracker.hpp"

namespace aurora::gfx {

void record_damaged_render_pass(VkCommandBuffer cmd,
                                VkFramebuffer framebuffer,
                                VkExtent2D render_extent,
                                VkRenderPass render_pass,
                                VkPipeline pipeline,
                                VkPipelineLayout pipeline_layout,
                                const std::vector<WindowRenderData>& windows,
                                const DamageTracker& damage_tracker) {
    if (!damage_tracker.has_damage()) {
        // Skip execution if frame has zero surface updates
        return;
    }

    // 1. Calculate overall dirty region bounding box and individual scissor rects
    Rect2D damage_bbox = damage_tracker.get_bounding_box(render_extent);
    std::vector<VkRect2D> scissors = damage_tracker.get_optimized_scissors(render_extent);

    // 2. Begin render pass targeting dirty bounding box area
    VkRenderPassBeginInfo render_pass_info{};
    render_pass_info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_BEGIN_INFO;
    render_pass_info.renderPass = render_pass;
    render_pass_info.framebuffer = framebuffer;
    render_pass_info.renderArea = damage_bbox.to_vk_rect(); // Restrict attachment load/store region

    // No full clear when doing regional update
    render_pass_info.clearValueCount = 0;
    render_pass_info.pClearValues = nullptr;

    vkCmdBeginRenderPass(cmd, &render_pass_info, VK_SUBPASS_CONTENTS_INLINE);
    vkCmdBindPipeline(cmd, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipeline);

    VkViewport viewport{
        0.0f, 0.0f, 
        static_cast<float>(render_extent.width), 
        static_cast<float>(render_extent.height), 
        0.0f, 1.0f
    };
    vkCmdSetViewport(cmd, 0, 1, &viewport);

    float screen_w = static_cast<float>(render_extent.width);
    float screen_h = static_cast<float>(render_extent.height);

    // 3. Render client quads clipped to damaged regions
    for (const auto& win : windows) {
        if (!win.descriptor_set) continue;

        Rect2D win_rect{
            static_cast<int32_t>(win.x),
            static_cast<int32_t>(win.y),
            static_cast<uint32_t>(win.width),
            static_cast<uint32_t>(win.height)
        };

        // Clip-test window quad against calculated dirty scissors
        for (const auto& scissor : scissors) {
            Rect2D scissor_rect{scissor.offset.x, scissor.offset.y, scissor.extent.width, scissor.extent.height};
            
            if (!win_rect.intersects(scissor_rect)) {
                // Skip windows completely outside current damaged region
                continue;
            }

            // Bind fine-grained scissor rect before draw execution
            vkCmdSetScissor(cmd, 0, 1, &scissor);

            WindowPushConstants pc{};
            pc.x = (win.x / screen_w) * 2.0f - 1.0f;
            pc.y = (win.y / screen_h) * 2.0f - 1.0f;
            pc.width = (win.width / screen_w) * 2.0f;
            pc.height = (win.height / screen_h) * 2.0f;
            pc.opacity = win.opacity;

            vkCmdPushConstants(cmd, pipeline_layout, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT | VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT,
                               0, sizeof(WindowPushConstants), &pc);

            vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(cmd, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipeline_layout,
                                    0, 1, &win.descriptor_set, 0, nullptr);

            vkCmdDraw(cmd, 6, 1, 0, 0);
        }
    }

    vkCmdEndRenderPass(cmd);
}

} // namespace aurora::gfx

```

This module provides the `wp_presentation` (Presentation Time protocol) server implementation in C++ for the Aurora Wayland compositor backend. It provides frame timestamping using `CLOCK_MONOTONIC`, sequence tracking, refresh period calculation, and `wp_presentation_feedback` event dispatching to measure end-to-end presentation latency.

---

### Component 1: Presentation Time Header (`aurora_presentation_time.hpp`)

```cpp
#ifndef AURORA_PRESENTATION_TIME_HPP
#define AURORA_PRESENTATION_TIME_HPP

#include <wayland-server-core.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <ctime>

// Generated server protocol header from presentation-time.xml
#include "presentation-time-server-protocol.h"

namespace aurora::wayland {

struct PresentationFrameInfo {
    uint64_t tv_sec{0};
    uint32_t tv_nsec{0};
    uint32_t refresh_ns{0};      // Screen refresh interval in nanoseconds (e.g., 6944444 for 144Hz)
    uint64_t sequence{0};        // Hardware vblank sequence counter
    uint32_t flags{0};           // WP_PRESENTATION_FEEDBACK_KIND_* bitfield flags
};

class PresentationFeedback {
public:
    explicit PresentationFeedback(wl_resource* resource);
    ~PresentationFeedback() = default;

    void send_sync_output(wl_resource* output_resource);
    void send_presented(const PresentationFrameInfo& info);
    void send_discarded();

    wl_resource* get_resource() const { return resource_; }

private:
    wl_resource* resource_{nullptr};
};

class PresentationTimeManager {
public:
    PresentationTimeManager(wl_display* display, clockid_t clock_id = CLOCK_MONOTONIC);
    ~PresentationTimeManager();

    clockid_t get_clock_id() const { return clock_id_; }

    // Surface Feedback Queue Management
    void add_feedback(wl_resource* surface_resource, wl_resource* feedback_resource);
    
    // Discards all queued feedbacks for a surface (e.g., frame dropped or replaced before display)
    void discard_surface_feedbacks(wl_resource* surface_resource);

    // Sends 'presented' event to all pending feedbacks for a surface after scanout/flip
    void notify_surface_presented(wl_resource* surface_resource,
                                  wl_resource* output_resource,
                                  const PresentationFrameInfo& info);

    void unregister_surface(wl_resource* surface_resource);

private:
    static void bind_global(wl_client* client, void* data, uint32_t version, uint32_t id);

    wl_display* display_{nullptr};
    wl_global* global_{nullptr};
    clockid_t clock_id_{CLOCK_MONOTONIC};

    std::unordered_map<wl_resource*, std::vector<std::unique_ptr<PresentationFeedback>>> pending_feedbacks_;
};

} // namespace aurora::wayland

#endif // AURORA_PRESENTATION_TIME_HPP

```

---

### Component 2: Implementation (`aurora_presentation_time.cpp`)

```cpp
#include "aurora_presentation_time.hpp"
#include <iostream>

namespace aurora::wayland {

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// PresentationFeedback
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

PresentationFeedback::PresentationFeedback(wl_resource* resource)
    : resource_(resource) {}

void PresentationFeedback::send_sync_output(wl_resource* output_resource) {
    if (resource_ && output_resource) {
        wp_presentation_feedback_send_sync_output(resource_, output_resource);
    }
}

void PresentationFeedback::send_presented(const PresentationFrameInfo& info) {
    if (!resource_) return;

    uint32_t tv_sec_hi = static_cast<uint32_t>(info.tv_sec >> 32);
    uint32_t tv_sec_lo = static_cast<uint32_t>(info.tv_sec & 0xFFFFFFFF);
    uint32_t seq_hi = static_cast<uint32_t>(info.sequence >> 32);
    uint32_t seq_lo = static_cast<uint32_t>(info.sequence & 0xFFFFFFFF);

    wp_presentation_feedback_send_presented(resource_,
                                             tv_sec_hi, tv_sec_lo,
                                             info.tv_nsec,
                                             info.refresh_ns,
                                             seq_hi, seq_lo,
                                             info.flags);
    wl_resource_destroy(resource_);
    resource_ = nullptr;
}

void PresentationFeedback::send_discarded() {
    if (!resource_) return;

    wp_presentation_feedback_send_discarded(resource_);
    wl_resource_destroy(resource_);
    resource_ = nullptr;
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Wayland Request Dispatchers
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

static void presentation_destroy(wl_client* client, wl_resource* resource) {
    wl_resource_destroy(resource);
}

static void presentation_feedback(wl_client* client, wl_resource* resource,
                                  wl_resource* surface_res, uint32_t id) {
    auto* manager = static_cast<PresentationTimeManager*>(wl_resource_get_user_data(resource));

    wl_resource* feedback_res = wl_resource_create(client,
                                                   &wp_presentation_feedback_interface,
                                                   wl_resource_get_version(resource), id);
    if (!feedback_res) {
        wl_client_post_no_memory(client);
        return;
    }

    wl_resource_set_implementation(feedback_res, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr);
    manager->add_feedback(surface_res, feedback_res);
}

static const struct wp_presentation_interface presentation_impl = {
    .destroy = presentation_destroy,
    .feedback = presentation_feedback,
};

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// PresentationTimeManager
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

PresentationTimeManager::PresentationTimeManager(wl_display* display, clockid_t clock_id)
    : display_(display), clock_id_(clock_id) {
    global_ = wl_global_create(display_, &wp_presentation_interface,
                               1, this, PresentationTimeManager::bind_global);
}

PresentationTimeManager::~PresentationTimeManager() {
    if (global_) wl_global_destroy(global_);
}

void PresentationTimeManager::bind_global(wl_client* client, void* data, uint32_t version, uint32_t id) {
    auto* manager = static_cast<PresentationTimeManager*>(data);
    wl_resource* resource = wl_resource_create(client, &wp_presentation_interface, version, id);
    
    wl_resource_set_implementation(resource, &presentation_impl, manager, nullptr);
    wp_presentation_send_clock_id(resource, static_cast<uint32_t>(manager->get_clock_id()));
}

void PresentationTimeManager::add_feedback(wl_resource* surface_resource, wl_resource* feedback_resource) {
    pending_feedbacks_[surface_resource].push_back(
        std::make_unique<PresentationFeedback>(feedback_resource)
    );
}

void PresentationTimeManager::discard_surface_feedbacks(wl_resource* surface_resource) {
    auto it = pending_feedbacks_.find(surface_resource);
    if (it != pending_feedbacks_.end()) {
        for (auto& feedback : it->second) {
            feedback->send_discarded();
        }
        pending_feedbacks_.erase(it);
    }
}

void PresentationTimeManager::notify_surface_presented(wl_resource* surface_resource,
                                                       wl_resource* output_resource,
                                                       const PresentationFrameInfo& info) {
    auto it = pending_feedbacks_.find(surface_resource);
    if (it == pending_feedbacks_.end()) return;

    for (auto& feedback : it->second) {
        if (output_resource) {
            feedback->send_sync_output(output_resource);
        }
        feedback->send_presented(info);
    }

    pending_feedbacks_.erase(it);
}

void PresentationTimeManager::unregister_surface(wl_resource* surface_resource) {
    discard_surface_feedbacks(surface_resource);
}

} // namespace aurora::wayland

```

---

### Component 3: Present Frame Cycle Integration

Example integration showing how `PresentationTimeManager` captures DRM hardware vblank timestamps and fires latency metrics to clients upon page flip completion:

```cpp
#include "aurora_presentation_time.hpp"
#include <xf86drm.h>
#include <sys/time.h>

void on_drm_page_flip_event(int fd, unsigned int sequence, unsigned int tv_sec,
                            unsigned int tv_usec, void* user_data) {
    auto* surface_resource = static_cast<wl_resource*>(user_data);

    aurora::wayland::PresentationFrameInfo frame_info{};
    frame_info.tv_sec = static_cast<uint64_t>(tv_sec);
    frame_info.tv_nsec = static_cast<uint32_t>(tv_usec) * 1000;
    frame_info.refresh_ns = 6944444; // 144Hz screen refresh duration in ns
    frame_info.sequence = static_cast<uint64_t>(sequence);
    
    // Flag indicating hardware clock precision & vsync alignment
    frame_info.flags = WP_PRESENTATION_FEEDBACK_KIND_VSYNC |
                       WP_PRESENTATION_FEEDBACK_KIND_HW_CLOCK |
                       WP_PRESENTATION_FEEDBACK_KIND_HW_COMPLETION;

    // Send presentation timestamps back to Wayland client
    presentation_mgr->notify_surface_presented(surface_resource, main_output_resource, frame_info);
}

```

This module implements low-latency swapchain presentation and frame pacing for the Aurora Vulkan Renderer using `VK_KHR_present_id` to assign monotonically increasing identifiers to rendered frames and `VK_KHR_present_wait` to block CPU execution until display hardware completes presentation.

---

### Component 1: Frame Pacer Header (`aurora_frame_pacer.hpp`)

```cpp
#ifndef AURORA_FRAME_PACER_HPP
#define AURORA_FRAME_PACER_HPP

#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

namespace aurora::gfx {

struct FramePacingConfig {
    uint32_t max_frames_in_flight{2};
    uint64_t present_timeout_ns{100'000'000}; // 100ms timeout
    bool enable_present_wait{true};
};

class FramePacer {
public:
    FramePacer(VkInstance instance, VkDevice device, VkSwapchainKHR swapchain, FramePacingConfig config = {});
    ~FramePacer() = default;

    // Wait until display hardware finishes presenting the given present_id
    VkResult wait_for_present(uint64_t present_id);

    // Submits present request attached with a unique incremental VkPresentIdKHR
    VkResult queue_present(VkQueue present_queue, 
                           uint32_t image_index, 
                           VkSemaphore wait_semaphore, 
                           uint64_t& out_present_id);

    uint64_t get_last_submitted_present_id() const { return current_present_id_; }

private:
    VkInstance instance_{VK_NULL_HANDLE};
    VkDevice device_{VK_NULL_HANDLE};
    VkSwapchainKHR swapchain_{VK_NULL_HANDLE};
    FramePacingConfig config_{};

    uint64_t current_present_id_{0};

    // Extension function pointer
    PFN_vkWaitForPresentKHR pfn_vkWaitForPresentKHR{nullptr};
};

} // namespace aurora::gfx

#endif // AURORA_FRAME_PACER_HPP

```

---

### Component 2: Frame Pacer Implementation (`aurora_frame_pacer.cpp`)

```cpp
#include "aurora_frame_pacer.hpp"
#include <stdexcept>

namespace aurora::gfx {

FramePacer::FramePacer(VkInstance instance, VkDevice device, VkSwapchainKHR swapchain, FramePacingConfig config)
    : instance_(instance), device_(device), swapchain_(swapchain), config_(config) {
    
    // Load extension function pointer dynamically
    pfn_vkWaitForPresentKHR = reinterpret_cast<PFN_vkWaitForPresentKHR>(
        vkGetInstanceProcAddr(instance_, "vkWaitForPresentKHR")
    );

    if (config_.enable_present_wait && !pfn_vkWaitForPresentKHR) {
        throw std::runtime_error("VK_KHR_present_wait extension enabled but vkWaitForPresentKHR function symbol not found.");
    }
}

VkResult FramePacer::wait_for_present(uint64_t present_id) {
```
