#### `CMakeLists.txt`
```cmake
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(aurora_compositor LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(WLROOTS REQUIRED wlroots)
pkg_check_modules(WAYLAND REQUIRED wayland-server)
pkg_check_modules(LIBINPUT REQUIRED libinput)
pkg_check_modules(XKB REQUIRED xkbcommon)
pkg_check_modules(PANGO REQUIRED pangocairo)
include_directories(${WLROOTS_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${WAYLAND_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${XKB_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${PANGO_INCLUDE_DIRS})
link_directories(${WLROOTS_LIBRARY_DIRS} ${WAYLAND_LIBRARY_DIRS} ${XKB_LIBRARY_DIRS} ${PANGO_LIBRARY_DIRS})

add_executable(aurora_compositor
  src/main.cpp
  src/compositor.cpp
  src/compositor.h
  src/shell.cpp
  src/shell.h
  src/panel.cpp
  src/launcher.cpp
  src/widgets/clock.cpp
  src/widgets/weather.cpp
  src/widgets/resource_monitor.cpp
)

target_compile_options(aurora_compositor PRIVATE ${WLROOTS_CFLAGS_OTHER})
target_link_libraries(aurora_compositor PRIVATE ${WLROOTS_LIBRARIES} ${WAYLAND_LIBRARIES} ${XKB_LIBRARIES} ${PANGO_LIBRARIES})
```

---

#### `src/main.cpp`
```cpp
#include "compositor.h"
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

static AuroraCompositor *g_comp = nullptr;

static void on_sigint(int) {
    if (g_comp) g_comp->shutdown();
    exit(0);
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    signal(SIGINT, on_sigint);
    AuroraCompositor comp;
    g_comp = &comp;
    if (!comp.init()) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Aurora: compositor init failed\n");
        return 1;
    }
    comp.run();
    comp.shutdown();
    return 0;
}
```

---

#### `src/compositor.h`
```cpp
#pragma once
#include <memory>
#include <wayland-server.h>
#include <wlr/backend.h>
#include <wlr/render/wlr_renderer.h>

class AuroraShell;

class AuroraCompositor {
public:
  AuroraCompositor();
  ~AuroraCompositor();
  bool init();
  void run();
  void shutdown();

  struct wl_display *display;
  struct wlr_backend *backend;
  struct wlr_renderer *renderer;

  std::unique_ptr<AuroraShell> shell;

private:
  void init_outputs();
  void init_input();
  void load_theme(const char *path);
};
```

---

#### `src/compositor.cpp`
```cpp
#include "compositor.h"
#include "shell.h"
#include <wlr/backend.h>
#include <wlr/render/wlr_renderer.h>
#include <wlr/util/log.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

AuroraCompositor::AuroraCompositor() : display(nullptr), backend(nullptr), renderer(nullptr) {}
AuroraCompositor::~AuroraCompositor() { shutdown(); }

bool AuroraCompositor::init() {
    wlr_log_init(WLR_DEBUG, NULL);
    display = wl_display_create();
    if (!display) return false;

    backend = wlr_backend_autocreate(display);
    if (!backend) return false;

    renderer = wlr_renderer_autocreate(backend);
    if (!renderer) return false;

    init_outputs();
    init_input();

    shell = std::make_unique<AuroraShell>(this);
    load_theme("assets/themes/aurora-dark.css");
    return true;
}

void AuroraCompositor::run() {
    wl_display_run(display);
}

void AuroraCompositor::shutdown() {
    if (backend) {
        wlr_backend_destroy(backend);
        backend = nullptr;
    }
    if (display) {
        wl_display_destroy(display);
        display = nullptr;
    }
}

void AuroraCompositor::init_outputs() {
    // Minimal: wlroots will create outputs via backend; additional output handling hooks go here.
}

void AuroraCompositor::init_input() {
    // Minimal input initialization; libinput integration handled by wlroots backend.
}

void AuroraCompositor::load_theme(const char *path) {
    // Simple loader: read CSS-like tokens; for now, keep default theme.
    (void)path;
}
```

    init();
}

    // cleanup if needed
}

void AuroraShell::init() {
    xdg_shell = wlr_xdg_shell_create(comp->display);
    layer_shell = zwlr_layer_shell_v1_create(comp->display);

    panel = std::make_unique<Panel>(comp);
    launcher = std::make_unique<Launcher>(comp);

    // Register xdg and layer shell listeners here (omitted for brevity)
    wlr_log(WLR_INFO, "AuroraShell initialized");
}

#### `src/launcher.cpp`
```cpp
#include "launcher.h"
#include "compositor.h"
#include <wlr/util/log.h>
#include <vector>
#include <string>

Launcher::Launcher(AuroraCompositor *c) : comp(c) {
    // Populate pinned apps and recommended items
    pinned = {"firefox.desktop", "code.desktop", "terminal.desktop", "files.desktop"};
    recommended = {"Project Chimera II", "Research Notes", "Aurora Wayland Guide", "System Monitor"};
    wlr_log(WLR_INFO, "Launcher initialized with %zu pinned apps", pinned.size());
}

Launcher::~Launcher() {}

void Launcher::open_app(const std::string &desktop_file) {
    // Use Kore or systemd user to launch; simplified: fork/exec
    pid_t pid = fork();
    if (pid == 0) {
        execl("/usr/bin/gtk-launch", "gtk-launch", desktop_file.c_str(), (char*)NULL);
        _exit(127);
    }
}
```

#include "clock.h"
#include <ctime>
#include <iostream>

ClockWidget::ClockWidget(AuroraCompositor *c) : comp(c) {}

ClockWidget::~ClockWidget() {}

void ClockWidget::draw() {
    time_t t = time(nullptr);
    struct tm tm;
    localtime_r(&t, &tm);
    char buf[64];
    strftime(buf, sizeof(buf), "%a %b %d  %I:%M %p", &tm);
    // For now print to stdout as placeholder; real implementation uses Cairo/Pango
    std::cout << "Clock: " << buf << std::endl;
}
